parameters.jsCode:
const output = [];

const normalizeEvidence = value =>
  String(value || "")
    .normalize("NFKC")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[\u200B-\u200D\uFEFF]/g, "")
    .replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]+/gu, "");

for (const item of $input.all()) {
  const d = item.json;
  const ai = d.validatedAi || {};

  const catalog = (d.tagCatalog || []).map(t => ({
    id: String(t.id?.$oid || t.id || ""),
    name: t.text || t.name || "",
    contractorLabel: t.contractorLabel || "",
    category: t.category,
    type: t.type,
    aliases: t.aliases || []
  }));

  const totalTags = Number(
    d.totalCatalogTags ?? catalog.length
  );

  const proposals = (ai.tagSuggestions || []).map(t => ({
    action: t.action,
    tagId: t.action === "reuse" ? t.tagId : undefined,
    text: t.text,
    contractorLabel:
      t.action === "reuse"
        ? catalog.find(c =>
            c.id === String(t.tagId?.$oid || t.tagId)
          )?.contractorLabel || ""
        : t.contractorLabel,
    category: t.category,
    type: t.type,
    requirementLevel: t.requirementLevel,
    confidence: t.confidence,
    evidence: t.evidence
  }));

  const source = String(d.sourceText || "");
  const normalizedSource = normalizeEvidence(source);

  const evidenceChecks = proposals.map((t, i) => {
    const normalizedQuote = normalizeEvidence(t.evidence);

    return {
      index: i,
      evidenceFound: Boolean(
        normalizedQuote &&
        normalizedSource.includes(normalizedQuote)
      )
    };
  });

  const instructions = [
    "Review procurement tag proposals independently.",
    "Return valid JSON only.",
    "",
    "RULES:",
    "- Reuse only when the catalog tag matches the evidence.",
    "- Create only distinct, reusable concepts.",
    "- Reject duplicates, synonyms and overlapping proposals.",
    "- Reject tags already covered by the catalog.",
    "- Reject unsupported or overly broad concepts.",
    "- Do not reject valid concepts just to limit catalog size.",
    "- Product and service categories are valid tags.",
    "- Do not create tags for quantities, prices, dates,",
    "  speeds, brands, models or minor variants.",
    "- specification = goods, services or deliverables.",
    "- contractor_requirement = bidder qualifications.",
    "- Check requirementLevel and evidence meaning.",
    "- Award announcements can support service-category tags.",
    "- Every create proposal must have a nonempty contractorLabel.",
    "- contractorLabel must express the same concept as text.",
    "- Example: Internet Service → Internet Service Provider.",
    "- text and contractorLabel are two labels for ONE tag, not duplicate tags.",
    "- A provider label does not change specification to contractor_requirement.",
    "- Reject unsupported licensing, certification or authorization in labels.",
    "- contractorLabel may paraphrase the concept.",
    "- For reuse proposals, the label comes from the existing catalog.",
    "- Report label corrections using tagSuggestions[index].",
    "- There is no fixed maximum number of tag suggestions.",
    "",
    "EVIDENCE:",
    "- Evidence matching tolerates whitespace, line breaks,",
    "  punctuation, Unicode formatting and letter case.",
    "- evidenceFound=true means normalized evidence matches",
    "  a continuous passage in the source document.",
    "- Do not reject evidence for formatting differences.",
    "- evidenceFound=false requires evidence correction or review.",
    "- Reject changed facts, incorrect numbers or unsupported claims.",
    "- A matching passage must support the proposed concept.",
    "- If evidenceFound=false, request a supported source passage.",
    "- Do not require English labels to appear in Thai source text.",
    "- Evaluate semantic support separately from formatting.",
    "",
    "REVIEW CONSISTENCY:",
    "- Reject only material errors in factual support,",
    "  tag identity, classification or evidence.",
    "- Do not reject valid tags merely because a more",
    "  specific label is possible.",
    "- Never recommend replacing a tag with itself.",
    "- Never include KEEP recommendations in errors.",
    "- Do not invent contractor qualifications or services.",
    "- Bidder registration and financial eligibility",
    "  are contractor_requirement concepts.",
    "- Delivery deadlines, warranty periods and",
    "  price evaluation methods are detailed conditions,",
    "  not standalone reusable tags.",
    "- Incidental installation with equipment does not",
    "  establish an independent installation service.",
    "- If a proposal is redundant or a generic contract",
    "  condition, recommend REMOVE.",
    "- Do not change a valid contractor_requirement",
    "  to specification.",
    "- If a tag is supported and correctly classified, accept it.",
    "",
    "DECISION:",
    "- APPROVE when all proposals are materially valid.",
    "- Otherwise REVISE.",
    "- Report only proposals that actually require changes.",
    "- Never report a valid proposal as an error.",
    "- Never recommend KEEP in the errors array.",
    "- Never recommend RENAME or CORRECT to the existing value.",
    "- If recommending REUSE, provide an exact catalog tagId.",
    "- Never invent tag IDs.",
    "- If recommending MERGE, identify the proposal to retain.",
    "- For each error, identify tagSuggestions[index],",
    "  explain the issue and recommend REMOVE, MERGE,",
    "  RENAME, REUSE or CORRECT.",
    "- Keep each error under 30 words.",
    "- Do not request changes to unrelated procurement fields.",
    "",
    "OUTPUT FORMAT:",
    '{"decision":"approve","errors":[]}',
    "OR",
    '{"decision":"revise","errors":[',
    '"tagSuggestions[1]: Duplicate concept. Recommendation: REMOVE.",',
    '"tagSuggestions[2]: Unsupported classification. Recommendation: CORRECT type."',
    "]}",
    "",
    "CATALOG:",
    JSON.stringify(catalog),
    "",
    "PROPOSALS:",
    JSON.stringify(proposals),
    "",
    "EVIDENCE CHECKS:",
    JSON.stringify(evidenceChecks)
  ];

  output.push({
    json: {
      ...d,
      reviewPrompt: instructions.join("\n"),
      reviewerEvidenceChecks: evidenceChecks,
      reviewerCatalogSize: totalTags
    }
  });
}

return output;
